description: Electricity Transmission Infrastructure Protection Code Overlays is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Tasmania Government's The List Data. The Electricity Transmission Infrastructure Protection Code Overlays have been produced by TasNetworks as statewide overlays for the Electricity Transmission Infrastructure Protection Code in the Tasmanian Planning Scheme. These overlays are to be used by local government in preparing the overlays for the code in their Local Provisions Schedules. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Tasmania Government's The List Data. Its tags are BOUNDARIES-Administrative. The portal shows 2025-06-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
